name: 해상도 일관성
description: 분석합니다 DPI/해상도 메타데이터 vs actual pixel dimensions, checks for AI model-specific output sizes, and validates EXIF image size declarations against actual dimensions.
mechanism:
The 해상도 consistency 분석 examines multiple signals:

1. **AI Model Resolution Matching**: 확인합니다 image dimensions against known AI model outputs (Stable Diffusion: 512², 768², 1024²; DALL-E 3: 1024×1024, 1792×1024; Midjourney: various).

2. **VAE Latent Space Detection**: Validates if dimensions are multiples of 64 (8× downsampled VAE latent space), 는 is characteristic of diffusion models.

3. **DPI Metadata Validation**: Cross-checks declared DPI (72 web, 96 screen, 240/300 print) against actual pixel dimensions. Inconsistencies suggest post-processing.

4. **EXIF Dimension Cross-check**: 비교합니다 ExifImageWidth/ExifImageHeight with actual decoded image dimensions 감지하기 위해 resizing.

5. **Megapixel Analysis**: 비교합니다 total pixel count against typical camera sensor outputs vs AI model capabilities.
parameters:
AI model 해상도s: SD 1.x (512²), SD XL (1024²), DALL-E 3 (1024², 1792×1024), Flux (1024²)
DPI standards: 72 (web), 96 (screen), 240/300 (print)
VAE alignment: multiples of 64
Camera megapixels: 12-108 MP typical
accuracy: 중간 - 70-80%. 리사이즈되지 않은 AI 출력에 가장 효과적. 이미지가 리사이즈되거나 잘리면 정확도가 크게 감소.
source: Latent Diffusion Model Architecture, JEITA CP-3451C
useCase: Quick AI 감지 screening based on dimensional 분석. Particularly effective for batch processing where images haven't been resized from their original AI 생성 dimensions.
strengths:
• 픽셀 처리 없는 빠른 차원 분석
• VAE 정렬 확인이 확산 모델에 매우 특이적
• DPI 불일치가 후처리를 드러냄
• 미묘한 리사이즈 감지
• 특정 AI 모델 출력 식별
limitations:
• 리사이즈나 크롭으로 쉽게 우회
• 카메라 해상도가 AI 출력과 겹침
• 소셜 미디어가 자동 리사이즈
• 업스케일러가 크기 변경
• DPI가 부정확하거나 없는 경우

references.title: Rombach, R. et al. (2022). High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models.
Podell, D. et al. (2023). SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis.
JEITA CP-3451C — Exif Standard Image Dimensions
